title: NEET UG 2026 — Official Question Paper
description: Complete National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (UG) 2026. 180 compulsory multiple choice questions across Biology, Chemistry, and Physics with cleaned formulas and diagrams.

instructions.en: The question paper comprises 180 compulsory multiple choice questions across Biology (90), Chemistry (45), and Physics (45). Each correct answer carries +4 marks and -1 for wrong answer. Total time: 180 minutes. Maximum marks: 720.
